headline: George and White lead Celtics past Milwaukee in Garden bounce-back victory
morning_brew: Wednesday night at the Garden was exactly what the doctor ordered. After stumbling around for a minute, the C's finally woke up and took down a tough Milwaukee squad. Seeing the offense actually click with that kind of fire was a massive relief, especially after the headache-inducing stretch we have navigated lately. That win was the shot in the arm we needed, proving this group has the grit to hold the parquet against a team that makes you earn every damn inch.

Paul George was electric from deep, and Derrick White played like he had a massive point to prove. When those two are finding the range, this team is a nightmare for anybody in the East. It wasn't perfect, and we had a few moments that made me want to throw my Dunks at the TV, but a seven-point win against a rival like the Bucks is nothing to sneeze at. I will take that kind of effort every single time we hit the floor, and frankly, it's about damn time.

Looking ahead, the Bruins are lacing up for a scrap against Pittsburgh tonight. It is a heavy schedule, but that is how we like it in the Hub. I am keeping an eye on the schedule because it feels like we are finally finding our stride, and I would love to see the B's keep their momentum rolling while we prepare for a Friday trip to Charlotte. Let's hope the intensity from Wednesday carries over into the rest of this stretch.
